verdict.rationale: YYLO is a CLI orchestrator for coding agents, so this axis applies, but the evidence never documents triggering an agent from a CI/CD pipeline or an automated fix-the-build or failing-test flow. A scriptable CLI with non-interactive runs (`yy pi --no-session`), exit-code receipts and a GitHub-issues integration are only building blocks a user could wire into CI themselves. The docs also state that merge 'schedules no suites', so tests are explicit project checks outside YYLO.

support.subject: As a developer, I can trigger an agent from CI/CD pipelines to fix a broken build or failing test
